tools.name: sienge_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers of the Sienge account, ordered by id. Filter by CPF or CNPJ, enterprise, or create and change dates. GET /customers.

tools.name: sienge_get_customer
tools.description: Show one customer with its phones, addresses, agents, procurators, spouse and family income. GET /customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: sienge_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer: a natural person (personType F, needs cpf and sex) or a legal person (personType J, needs cnpj). POST /customers. The call is never retried: check sienge_list_customers before you create the same customer again.

tools.name: sienge_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies (business units) of the Sienge account, ordered by id. GET /companies.

tools.name: sienge_list_enterprises
tools.description: List the enterprises (construction projects) of the account. Filter by company or type. GET /enterprises.

tools.name: sienge_list_creditors
tools.description: List the creditors (suppliers and other payees), filtered by CPF, CNPJ or name. GET /creditors.

tools.name: sienge_get_creditor
tools.description: Show one creditor with its contacts, phones, address, bank data and tax classification. GET /creditors/{creditorId}.

tools.name: sienge_list_sales_contracts
tools.description: List sales contracts, filtered by customer, company, enterprise, unit, number or dates. GET /sales-contracts.

tools.name: sienge_get_sales_contract
tools.description: Show one sales contract with its customers, units, payment conditions, brokers and commissions. GET /sales-contracts/{salesContractId}.

tools.name: sienge_list_receivable_bills
tools.description: List the receivable bills (accounts receivable titles) of one customer. GET /accounts-receivable/receivable-bills.

tools.name: sienge_list_receivable_installments
tools.description: List the installments (parcelas) of one receivable bill with due dates and amounts. GET /accounts-receivable/receivable-bills/{receivableBillId}/installments.

tools.name: sienge_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders by order date, status, approval, supplier or building. GET /purchase-orders.

tools.name: sienge_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Show one purchase order: status, supplier, building, totals and payment condition. GET /purchase-orders/{purchaseOrderId}.

tools.name: sienge_list_purchase_invoices
tools.description: List purchase invoices (notas fiscais de compra) by issue period, company, supplier, document or number. GET /purchase-invoices.

tools.name: sienge_list_units
tools.description: List the real-estate units (imóveis) of the account, ordered by id descending. GET /units.

tools.name: sienge_get_unit
tools.description: Show one unit with its enterprise, areas, address, evaluations and groupings. GET /units/{unitId}.

tools.name: sienge_list_departments
tools.description: List the departments of the account, optionally filtered by name or active state. GET /departments.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sienge_create_customer, sienge_list_purchase_invoices · Private data: sienge_get_creditor, sienge_list_purchase_invoices · Public sink: sienge_create_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sienge_create_customer, sienge_list_purchase_invoices · Private data: sienge_get_creditor, sienge_list_purchase_invoices · Public sink: sienge_create_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
